description: This file is a Perl test script that verifies the functionality of the 'join_paths' utility from the Git::SVN::Utils module. It defines a series of test cases with input arrays and expected path strings, then runs assertions to check if 'join_paths' produces the correct output for each test case.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Utility function to concatenate parts into a normalized filesystem path, handling various edge cases such as empty strings, undef values, and leading/trailing slashes.
